instruction: A seahorse carved from clear leaded crystal, its curled prehensile tail and ridged crown catching prismatic rainbows through faceted flanks. Light refracts and pools inside the transparent body, and polished bevels along its spine sparkle like cut gemstone.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE Crystal Seahorse in a glass/crystal style. A seahorse carved from clear leaded crystal, its curled prehensile tail and ridged crown catching prismatic rainbows through faceted flanks. Light refracts and pools inside the transparent body, and polished bevels along its spine sparkle like cut gemstone. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
